# Nonprofit Fundraising Best Practices

## Donor Relationship Management

### Build Strong Relationships
- **Personalize communications** - Address donors by name and reference their giving history
- **Show impact** - Demonstrate how donations make a difference with stories and data
- **Practice the 80/20 rule** - 80% relationship building, 20% asking
- **Thank donors promptly** - Acknowledge gifts within 48 hours

### Donor Retention
- Create a stewardship plan for different donor levels
- Provide regular updates throughout the year
- Celebrate milestones and anniversaries
- Survey donors to understand their motivations

## Fundraising Strategy

### Diversify Revenue Streams
- Individual donations (online, direct mail, events)
- Major gifts and planned giving
- Corporate partnerships
- Foundation grants
- Monthly/recurring giving programs
- Peer-to-peer fundraising

### Set Clear Goals
- Establish specific, measurable targets
- Track metrics (donor retention rate, average gift size, cost per dollar raised)
- Create a fundraising calendar
- Align fundraising with organizational strategic plan

## Digital Best Practices

### Optimize Online Giving
- Make donation process simple (3 clicks or less)
- Ensure mobile responsiveness
- Offer multiple payment options
- Use suggested gift amounts strategically
- Enable recurring gifts with one checkbox

### Leverage Social Media
- Share compelling stories, not just asks
- Use video content to show impact
- Engage supporters year-round
- Create shareable content for peer-to-peer fundraising

## Communication Excellence

### Storytelling
- Focus on beneficiaries and impact
- Use the "problem-solution-impact" framework
- Include photos and videos when possible
- Make donors the hero of the story

### Email Marketing
- Segment your lists for targeted messaging
- Write compelling subject lines
- Include clear calls-to-action
- Test and optimize send times

## Compliance & Transparency

- Maintain accurate donor records
- Provide tax receipts promptly
- Be transparent about overhead and program costs
- Follow data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)
- Register in required states for charitable solicitation

## Special Campaigns

### Annual Appeals
- Start planning 3-4 months in advance
- Use multi-channel approach (mail, email, social, phone)
- Create urgency with deadlines
- Highlight year-end tax benefits

### Events
- Ensure events align with mission
- Calculate ROI including staff time
- Create experiences that engage attendees
- Follow up quickly with participants

## Team & Board Development

- Train staff and board in fundraising fundamentals
- Set board giving expectations (100% participation)
- Provide talking points and tools
- Celebrate fundraising wins together

## Key Performance Indicators to Track

- Donor retention rate (aim for 45%+)
- Average gift size
- Cost to raise a dollar (ideally under $0.25)
- Monthly donor growth
- Email open and click-through rates
- Website conversion rates

**Remember:** Effective fundraising is about building authentic relationships and clearly communicating your impact. Focus on your mission, and the money will follow.
